(RS_CRYPTO_02206)
While this enables applications to create a ready-to-go RandomGeneratorCtx, it cannot
be guaranteed that seeding of the RandomGeneratorCtx is possible at this point in
time, e.g., due to a lack of entropy.As applications shall be prevented from modifying
the state of global-state RandomGeneratorCtx, applications shall also not be able to
trigger the seeding of any global-state RandomGeneratorCtx.
